label: propranolol 80 mg oral, fasted, n=6 men, 2-8 h only
note: Salem SA, McDevitt DG. Br J Clin Pharmacol 1984;17(1):31-36, p.32 Table 1, 80 mg row (PMC1463293). Six healthy men, overnight fast. Fluorometric assay (Shand 1970). Samples at 2, 3, 5 and 8 h only, so absorption and Tmax are not tested. Same subjects as the 40 mg file.
